Braiins Confirms Bitcoin Mining Share Hijacking, Warns of Stratum V1 Security Risks

Bitcoin mining pool Braiins confirmed that attackers have exploited the lack of pool authentication in unsecured Stratum V1 connections, redirecting mining shares to attackers while miners continue operating normally. In one incident, more than 1,000 mining sites lost their pool connections within the same second. Nvidia Agrees to $290M Settlement Over Crypto Mining Revenue Disclosures

According to Reuters, Nvidia has agreed to pay $290 million to settle an investor class action lawsuit filed in 2018. The plaintiffs alleged that Nvidia misled investors by attributing rapid growth in gaming-related revenue to gaming demand rather than cryptocurrency mining, understating the contribution of crypto miners to its GPU sales. Franklin Crypto Index ETF to Add HYPE Holdings on December 1

According to an SEC filing, the Franklin Crypto Index ETF will add Hyperliquid (HYPE) to its holdings on or around December 1. Its underlying index, the CF Institutional Digital Asset Index, will add HYPE on December 1, bringing its constituents to BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, DOGE, ADA, XLM, and HYPE. The ETF will allocate assets according to their index weights, with the index continuing to rebalance quarterly. — link

U.S. Core PCE Inflation Rises to 3.3% in October, Highest Since November 2023

The U.S. core PCE price index rose 3.3% year-over-year in October, above expectations of 3.2% and up from 3.1% previously, reaching its highest level since November 2023. The monthly increase was 0.3%, in line with expectations. Headline PCE inflation rose 3.8% year-over-year, its highest level since May, while the monthly increase was 0.3%, matching expectations. According to SoSoValue data, spot Bitcoin ETFs saw a total net outflow of $232 million on November 24 (ET), marking six consecutive days of net outflows. Fidelity Crypto Adds Aave, Chainlink, and Uniswap Tokens, Expanding Supported Assets to Eight

According to Cryptobriefing, Fidelity’s cryptocurrency trading platform Fidelity Crypto has added three decentralized finance (DeFi) tokens—Aave (AAVE), Chainlink (LINK), and Uniswap (UNI)—allowing eligible U.S. customers to trade them via Fidelity Crypto accounts, including certain crypto IRA accounts. 2月20日，美国最高法院裁定，《国际紧急经济权力法》未授权总统征收关税。3月11日，美方就中国等16个经济体的制造业产能过剩启动301调查。（美国最高法院、美国贸易代表办公室）

《华尔街日报》11月24日报道，美方拟对这些经济体的多数输美商品加征关税。路透社称，美方拟遵守协定税率上限，欧盟和日韩为15%，马来西亚为19%。墨西哥和挪威或暂不加税。（华尔街日报、路透社）

中美关税休战明年1月10日到期。若续期，特朗普第二任期对华加税预计仍以20%为限，尚余7.5个百分点。调查结果最快24日下午公布。白宫和美国贸易代表办公室未回应路透社。（路透社）
